name: zhiliao
description: 知了——面向知乎用户的实时语音辩论 Web 产品

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,web,server -c yellow,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @zhiliao/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @zhiliao/web dev" "pnpm --filter @zhiliao/server dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @zhiliao/web build && pnpm --filter @zhiliao/server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @zhiliao/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @zhiliao/server typecheck
